notes: A job you've marked Confirmed is no longer chased for a confirmation. The nudges read the status - what the app watched you send - while the chip reads the stage you set, so a job confirmed on the phone sat there saying Confirmed and 'not confirmed yet' in the same row. Where you've set a status of Confirmed or later by hand, the two nudges that exist to get a job confirmed stand down; mark it back to Quoted and they return, because then you're saying it isn't confirmed. Jobs left on automatic behave exactly as before.
